visual_logic.color_palette: Electric violet body; the crest is a sunset gradient of deep orange to magenta with black borders.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Iridescent 'clay' shimmer on the crest; soft downy pycnofibers around the neck ruff.
visual_logic.eyes: Pale blue eyes that contrast sharply with the warm crest colors.
visual_logic.environment: Soft-focus Crato landscape; pale buff limestone and vibrant green ferns (Ruffordia).

pose: Full display pose; standing on the ground with wings partially spread, head tilted back to maximize the visual impact of the towering sail.
